claims.title: Excitation-preserving repair needs acquired carrier survival and retained reward, beyond a repair committor

status: Source-derived arguments and inspected producer replay; new extensions separately identified as integration-derived.
interface: Negative qualification of a proposed hBN excitation-preserving repair chain, plus conditional full-state Markov reward certificates. No defect-to-healed reaction, surviving outgoing excitation, chain kernel or retained lattice repair is acquired. New adaptive reward bounds and countermodels assume an explicit full configuration/carrier state and a defined retention horizon.
limits: Acquire a concrete repair reaction and retained outgoing excitation with state-resolved branching, photoionization/loss, damage and energy budgets; construct and validate the full configuration-level joint kernel or a conservative reward potential. Measure retained terminal benefit against matched thermal/electrical/chemical and known excitation-chain controls. Resolve loading/propagation compatibility before scaling a proposed chain.
